description: Geoscience Australia - Major Dam Walls 2012 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Geoscience Australia. This dataset presents locations of major dam walls in Australia. The major dam walls were digitized in 2012 from orthophotos and satellite imagery held within Geoscience Australia. The primary information source used to identify and locate the dam walls was publically available data downloaded from the Australian National Committee on Large Dams (ANCOLD) website. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Geoscience Australia. Its tags are built, infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
